She is smiling and looking towards the stage. Yellow captions are fixed at the bottom center. The fan in the inset is now singing along enthusiastically. (4) A wide shot of the massive stadium is shown in the main frame, revealing thousands of glowing pink lights from the audience's light sticks in the dark. (5) The main frame switches to a close-up of another performer with blonde hair (Rosé) singing into a microphone, wearing a white dress with lace details. The background lighting is a grid of soft white lights. The fan inset remains throughout.
